inputs.text: A sunny cartoon backyard, completely empty, no people, no ball. Bright green lawn in the foreground. Straight ahead across the back, a tall light-brown wooden plank fence. On the left a leafy round cartoon tree. In the middle, in front of the fence, two terracotta flower pots with red flowers standing a few steps apart on the grass like a little goal. On the right a small wooden crate on the grass. Clear blue sky with a few puffy white clouds, warm afternoon sunlight, soft shadows. High-quality 3D animated feature film still, stylized cartoon environment with soft rounded shapes, warm vibrant colour palette, soft global illumination, clean crisp render, no noise, no grain.
